scenes.title: Course contre la montre  (Race Against the Clock)
scenes.summary: In a taxi on her way to pick up Charlotte Gainsbourg, Andrea scrambles to manage multiple crises. She orders Camille to read an urgent script by Oscar Rondo immediately so she can bluff her way through the meeting.

scenes.title: L'enthousiasme de Charlotte  (Charlotte's Enthusiasm)
scenes.summary: At the airport, Charlotte Gainsbourg asks Andrea if Oscar Rondo's script is good. Andrea lies and praises it, just before receiving a text saying it is terrible and watching Oscar arrive unexpectedly to celebrate.

scenes.title: La nouvelle direction  (The New Leadership)
scenes.summary: Andrea gathers the ASK team to present her bold strategy to compensate for Mathias's imminent departure, emphasizing television series and new talent, while secretly agonizing over her blunder with Charlotte.

scenes.title: La robe des César  (The César Dress)
scenes.summary: In an upscale boutique, Noémie searches for the perfect dress to accompany Mathias to the César ceremony, choosing a bold and contrasting outfit designed for seduction rather than conventional elegance.

scenes.title: Le projet d'Oscar  (Oscar's Project)
scenes.summary: Charlotte Gainsbourg reads lines from a bizarre science-fiction script with her childhood friend Oscar, begging Andréa to secretly extract her from the project without hurting his feelings.

scenes.title: La signature de Mathias  (Mathias's Signature)
scenes.summary: Mathias officially signs over his shares to leave ASK, delivering a solemn farewell speech while Andréa and Gabriel question his secret future plans.

scenes.title: Le départ de Noémie  (Noémie's Departure)
scenes.summary: Noémie packs her belongings and entrusts her desk bonsai to Hervé, sharing a warm farewell with Camille and Hervé as they plan a goodbye drink.

scenes.title: La clé de l'agence  (The Agency Key)
scenes.summary: As Mathias steps into the elevator with his boxes, Gabriel and Andréa intercept him to recover his agency key before the doors close.

scenes.title: Le départ de Mathias  (Mathias's Departure)
scenes.summary: As Mathias prepares to leave ASK for the last time, Andréa asks him to return his office keys, leaving him stunned by how quickly he has been cast aside.

scenes.title: La crèche parentale  (The Cooperative Daycare)
scenes.summary: Andréa arrives late to a meeting at a cooperative daycare center and is stunned by the demanding chores required of parents, prompting a tense talk with Colette.

scenes.title: Le oui de Xavier Beauvois  (Xavier Beauvois Says Yes)
scenes.summary: Colette calls Andréa with exhilarating news that director Xavier Beauvois accepted her project, and the couple plans their evening celebration at home.

scenes.title: La frayeur du soir  (The Evening Fright)
scenes.summary: Coming home late to their apartment, Andréa accidentally startles Colette in the dark hallway. Colette comforts crying baby Flora in her arms while Andréa apologizes for frightening them.

scenes.title: Les pleurs de décharge  (Release Crying)
scenes.summary: In their apartment, Colette notices that baby Flora stops crying when held. Andréa quotes parenting books about release crying and emotional safety, before an exhausted Colette heads off to sleep.

scenes.title: Le déménagement de bureau  (The Office Move)
scenes.summary: Andréa catches Gabriel moving his boxes into the spacious office at ASK. When Gabriel claims the desk because Andréa is constantly busy, she humorously counters by offering him a change of floor.

scenes.title: La fausse jambe cassée  (The Fake Broken Leg)
scenes.summary: To rescue Charlotte Gainsbourg from a disastrous sci-fi movie without hurting her childhood friend's feelings, Andréa claims Charlotte broke her leg, rushing in a prop master to fit a fake plaster cast.

scenes.title: La visite d'Oscar  (Oscar's Visit)
scenes.summary: Oscar visits Charlotte to inspect her supposed injury, offering ridiculous sci-fi plot adjustments before they have an honest conversation and pivot to an animated film project.

scenes.title: Sur le tapis rouge  (On the Red Carpet)
scenes.summary: At the César Awards red carpet, Andréa is stunned to discover that rival StarMédia agent Élise Formain has poached Mimie Mathy with lavish promises of limousines and VIP treatment.

scenes.title: Sur le tapis rouge  (On the Red Carpet)
scenes.summary: At the Césars ceremony, Charlotte Gainsbourg graciously invites Mimie Mathy onto the red carpet for the photocall, while Gabriel proudly steps aside to let them shine together.

scenes.title: La robe de Noémie  (Noémie's Dress)
scenes.summary: Arriving at the Césars, Noémie worries about her flashy dress while Mathias tries to comfort her, but the mood turns bitter when an acquaintance dismissively calls Noémie his little assistant.

scenes.title: La déception de Sophia  (Sophia's Disappointment)
scenes.summary: Seated in the middle of the auditorium, Sophia realizes from her seat placement that she won't win the César for Best Female Newcomer, and storms out of the hall when the winner is announced.

scenes.title: Départ précipité  (A Hasty Departure)
scenes.summary: After losing the César for Best Female Newcomer, a heartbroken Sofia rushes out of the ceremony hall. Gabriel follows her into the lobby, confronting the security staff and comforting Sofia as she struggles with disappointment.
scenes.location: Hall de la cérémonie des César

scenes.title: Une vraie actrice  (A True Actress)
scenes.summary: In the quiet backstage hallway, Sofia tells Gabriel that she wants to give up, but Gabriel insists that she quit her desk job at ASK to focus entirely on acting. When Charlotte Gainsbourg asks for her autograph on her cast, Sofia realizes she is recognized as a true actress.

scenes.title: Le coup de théâtre  (The Dramatic Twist)
scenes.summary: Director Xavier Beauvois takes the stage to accept the César for Best Director and makes a stunning announcement about his next film. Sitting in the audience, Andréa and Gabriel are struck dumb when Xavier reveals his producer is none other than Mathias Barneville.

scenes.title: L'offensive d'Andréa  (Andréa's Offensive)
scenes.summary: At the César ceremony, Hervé alerts Andréa and Gabriel to breaking news that Mathias is becoming an independent producer at Mediawan. Refusing to lose their clients, Andréa rallies the agency to go on the offensive and calls an urgent morning strategy meeting.

scenes.title: Loin de la fête  (Far from the Party)
scenes.summary: In a taxi leaving the Césars, Noémie convinces Mathias to skip the lavish afterparty at Fouquet's so they can avoid the industry crowd. Mathias gladly agrees to prioritize her wishes and return straight to the hotel together.

scenes.title: Folle de toi  (Mad About You)
scenes.summary: As Paris glides by through the taxi windows, Mathias laughs affectionately at Noémie's joyful humor before she passionately declares her love. They share a tender romantic embrace, celebrating their shared future as the season premiere concludes.
